pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches exhibit complex, non-smooth geometries with high-frequency, jagged edge gradients. The morphology is stellate or 'toothed', where individual patches extend sharp angular projections into the surrounding light regions. Patch area significantly dominates the total pixel surface compared to the interstitial network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network consists of cream-colored pathways forming a continuous graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and uniform across the flank, with high continuity and distinct pixel-level transitions at patch boundaries.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a dense, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The frequency of the bristles creates a nearly continuous but textured line against the out-of-focus background foliage.
